$comment: Declarative form of the record fields a worker/executor reports. Derived from src/service.mjs getTaskResult consumption (lines 192-263) and the attempt checks in src/tasks.mjs validateTask (lines 366-378). There is no runtime producer yet: this is the shape the future executor adapter must write into a task record before getTaskResult reads it, NOT a get_task_result envelope (no taskId, status, schemaVersion or sanitized flag). It is deliberately stricter than today's runtime tolerance in three ways: unknown keys are rejected, testRuns[].exitCode is required as evidence, and attempts[].outcome must be a non-empty string when present. Checked by src/contracts/validate.mjs; the meta block is ignored by the checker.

attempts.description: Every worker attempt, in dispatch order.

model.description: provider/model actually used for this attempt.

startedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds, injected by the caller.

finishedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds when the attempt ended; null while running.

outcome.description: Outcome label; null while the attempt is still running. Never validated by the current runtime.

testRuns.description: Test commands actually executed, with their exit codes.

command.description: Optional: the runtime tolerates a run reported without a command (src/service.mjs:192-199) and turns that into a limitation instead of evidence. A future adapter that claims success must still record it.

exitCode.description: Exit code reported by the process; -1 when the run was aborted.

outputTail.description: Bounded log tail; UTF-8 sequences are never cut mid-character.

outputTruncated.description: True when the tail does not contain the full output.

diff.description: Unified diff, capped at 1 MiB, or null when no artifact was recorded.

changedFiles.description: Repository-relative paths changed by the task.

limitations.description: Explicit statements about missing or partial evidence; never empty for an unverified success claim.

known.description: False until a paid provider is authorized; unknown cost is never reported as zero.

evidenceLevel.description: Evidence level of the result, per docs/definition-of-done.md.
